astronaut_face.png
==================

Positive test fixture for Haar *face detection* (not recognition).

Content:
  Photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins.

License / rights:
  NASA photograph. scikit-image documents this file as having no known
  copyright restrictions and being released into the public domain.
  NASA should be credited as the source. This project uses the image
  only as an automated-test fixture for bounding-box detection, not
  for identification, advertising, or any implied NASA endorsement.

Obtained from:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png
  (scikit-image v0.25.2, 512×512 PNG)

scikit-image documentation of the same image:
  https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut
  Original NASA Great Images / Flickr pointer cited there: https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn

SHA-256 of the bundled file:
  88431cd9653ccd539741b555fb0a46b61558b301d4110412b5bc28b5e3ea6cb5

This is not a photograph collected from a random web search, and it
is not used to identify a person in the application.
